newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks fall in late trade, turnover shrinks.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks fall in late trade, turnover shrinks.

text.p: Taiwan share prices remained lower in late Monday trade with investors retreating to the sidelines amid a lack of market-moving news, brokers said.
With 45 minutes to go, at 0315 GMT, the weighted index was down 53.09 points or 0.65 percent to 8,088.03. Turnover was a very light T$38 billion.

Brokers said Taiwan's unexpected decision to cut diplomatic ties with the Bahamas late on Sunday hurt sentiment as the move triggered worries of further diplomatic fallout among Taiwan's remaining 30 allies.

"Market sentiment is sluggish at the moment, but the fact that the market did not plunge over the diplomatic setback showed most people agree the current level is a good support," Yungli Securities' analyst Chen Han-chung said.
